description: Approximate monthly cost of living for one person, in EUR, rounded to the nearest 10. withoutRent is Numbeo's country estimate for a single person excluding rent; withRent adds the average rent of a 1-bedroom apartment outside the city centre as published by Wise. Country averages hide large differences between cities. Estimates, not live data.

conversion.note: Figures reported in USD or GBP were converted to EUR at fixed rates.
